Every time an ACH transfer returns, TP sends:
1) `hold` (`-X`)
2) `hold_release` (`+X`)
3) `withdrawal` (`-X`)
4) `deposit` (`+X` for `ACH CREDIT RETURN`)
ALL FOUR `tran_events` have the SAME `trace_id = ach_...`!
And because `TranEvents::Upserter` rolls up all `tran_events` with the same `trace_id` into a SINGLE `trans` row and sets `trans.amount_in_cents = SUM(tran_events.amount_in_cents)`, when an ACH returns, `-X + X - X + X = 0`! So `TranEvents::Upserter` collapses both the send (`withdrawal`) and the return (`deposit`) into a SINGLE `trans` row with `amount_in_cents = 0`!
